 "content": "from collections import Counter

def runs(values, color):
    out = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(values):
        if values[i] != color:
            i += 1
            continue
        j = i
        while j + 1 < len(values) and values[j + 1] == color:
            j += 1
        out.append((i, j))
        i = j + 1
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    edge_colors = [g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in (0, w - 1) if g[r][c] != bg]
    edge_colors += [g[r][c] for r in (0, h - 1) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] != bg]
    rail = Counter(edge_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    left = runs([g[r][0] for r in range(h)], rail)
    right = runs([g[r][w - 1] for r in range(h)], rail)
    top = runs(g[0], rail)
    bottom = runs(g[h - 1], rail)
    markers = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != rail]

    if left and right:
        for r, c, color in markers:
            if any(a <= r <= b for a, b in left):
                idx = next(i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(left) if a <= r <= b)
                a, b = left[idx]
                u, v = right[min(idx, len(right) - 1)]
                rr = u + min(r - a, v - u)
                # Ray enters the left portal, wraps to its paired right portal,
                # then continues in the same leftward direction.
                for cc in range(c - 1, 0, -1):
                    if g[r][cc] == bg: g[r][cc] = color
                for cc in range(w - 2, -1, -1):
                    if g[rr][cc] == bg: g[rr][cc] = color
                g[r][c] = 4
            elif any(a <= r <= b for a, b in right):
                idx = next(i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(right) if a <= r <= b)
                a, b = right[idx]
                u, v = left[min(idx, len(left) - 1)]
                rr = u + min(r - a, v - u)
                # Ray enters the right portal, wraps to its paired left portal,
                # then continues rightward.
                for cc in range(c + 1, w - 1):
                    if g[r][cc] == bg: g[r][cc] = color
                for cc in range(1, w):
                    if g[rr][cc] == bg: g[rr][cc] = color
                g[r][c] = 4
        return g

    if top and bottom:
        for r, c, color in markers:
            if any(a <= c <= b for a, b in bottom):
                idx = next(i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(bottom) if a <= c <= b)
                a, b = bottom[idx]
                u, v = top[min(idx, len(top) - 1)]
                cc = u + min(c - a, v - u)

                    if g[rr][cc] == bg: g[rr][cc] = color
                g[r][c] = 4
            elif any(a <= c <= b for a, b in top):
                idx = next(i for i, (a, b) in enumerate(top) if a <= c <= b)
                a, b = top[idx]
                u, v = bottom[min(idx, len(bottom) - 1)]
                cc = u + min(c - a, v - u)
                # Upward ray wraps from top portal to paired bottom portal.
                for rr in range(r - 1, 0, -1):
                    if g[rr][c] == bg: g[rr][c] = color
                for rr in range(h - 2, -1, -1):
                    if g[rr][cc] == bg: g[rr][cc] = color
                g[r][c] = 4
